params.body:
Replaces #6. #7 was merged first and already carried #6's changes to the files they share (`astro.config.ts`, `Layout.astro`, `index.astro`), so #6 no longer merges. This brings the rest of #6 onto main.

Main does not build without it: `src/pages/index.astro` imports `isMenuVisible` from `src/lib/queries.ts`, which only this PR adds.

## What it adds

- `menuSettings` singleton ("Toon de kaart op de site", off by default), shown in the Studio at the top of Menukaart.
- `isMenuVisible()`: true only when the switch is on and a category has items. Until then /kaart redirects home and a home button to /kaart is not rendered (the nav, description and sitemap parts are already on main via #7).
- Line icons on the home buttons, per target page.
- The button field in the Studio notes that a menu button appears only once the menu is switched on.

## Checked

- On a fresh branch from main: `astro build` against the live dataset (read only) and `tsc --noEmit`, both clean.
- The resulting tree is identical to the branch tested for #6 and #7 together.

#6 can be closed.

No content was written to Sanity.
params.title: Menu behind a Studio switch, icons on the home buttons (replaces #6)
